result:
I’d make it so people could genuinely feel, for a moment, the impact of their actions on others.

Not as guilt or punishment—just clear, unavoidable understanding. Most cruelty survives because distance makes other people feel less real. If that distance collapsed, even briefly, I think a lot of systems—war, exploitation, neglect—would become much harder to maintain.
